text:
jess: Quick heads-up — after bumping client-sdk -> v18.1 in the platform services, our streaming connections to Redwood production started reconnecting ~1-2x/min. Not sure if it's backpressure, keepalive, or auth refresh. Anyone hit this?

andre: I saw a similar spike in our staging metrics. Could be the change that toggled `refresh_on_401` default to false. @jess can you paste the client config?

jess: config snippet: 
```json
{"stream": {"retry": true, "maxReconnects": 3, "backpressureMs": 50}, "auth": {"refresh_on_401": false}}
```
Using token rotation (short-lived) + refresh webhook.

maya: fwiw, in node 18.1 we also changed the streaming keepalive to 15s (was 30s). That made some proxies drop idle sockets more aggressively. Maybe combined with refresh_on_401=false leads to unexpected reconnects.

tom: can we reproduce with a simple local repro? run: 
```bash
TOKEN=... curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood-inference.local/v1/streams?model=gpt-x -N
```
I can spin up a small harness to hammer it and capture tcpdump.

jess: good idea. I'll try that. Also saw some 401s in the logs before reconnect: `stream-handler error: 401 Unauthorized` then `reconnect attempt 1`.

andre: if auth refresh isn't automatic on 401, reconnect will fail mid-stream until token rotation completes. Two mitigation paths: set `refresh_on_401: true` in runtime config, or add a compatibility shim that refreshes before reconnect.

sre-oncall: Re: proxies — our infra team confirmed that ELB idle timeout is still 60s, but some customers' proxies are 30s. lowering keepalive to 15s will increase reconnects. Consider exposing `keepAliveMs` with default 30.

maya: propose we add a short-term shim in client v18.1: if `stream.retry` and `auth.refresh_on_401 == false`, log a WARN and attempt a pre-reconnect token refresh. I'll open a tiny PR that adds a `maybeRefreshToken()` path before reconnects.

jess: that sounds good. @andre can you review the PR? Also can we add an e2e test in CI that runs a streaming scenario with token rotation to avoid regressions?

andre: yep I can review. I'll also add a flakey-stability job to run a 2-min streaming smoke test on merge to main.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for fix/shim-auth-refresh -> staging (sha: bc1a2f) :rocket:

jess: thanks everyone — I'll follow up with logs and the local repro results in this thread. :thumbsup:
